title: Determinants of eHealth Systems Adoption: Reproducibility Bundle (screening log, evidence base, scoring data, and analysis code)
description:
Reproducibility bundle for the manuscript Determinants of eHealth Systems Adoption: A Systematic Review and Multi-Case Analysis (U-T-I-O Model). Contains the complete machine-readable record of the executed systematic search and screening pipeline, the extracted evidence base, the U-T-I-O Alignment Index (UAI) scoring data, and the analysis scripts needed to reproduce the PRISMA funnel and figures.

Search: PubMed/MEDLINE and IEEE Xplore, executed June 2026 (1,688 records identified). Scopus, Web of Science, and CINAHL could not be searched owing to unavailable institutional subscription access. Funnel: 1,688 identified → 8 duplicates removed → 1,680 screened (two documented stages) → 549 assessed at full text/abstract → 48 excluded → 501 included studies, plus 4 national implementation cases.

Contents: unified deduplicated corpus; complete 1,680-record screening decision log with reason codes and justifications; 501-study evidence-extraction matrix with U-T-I-O domain coding; full-text exclusion table (coded); the screening reliability comparison between the primary LLM screen and an AI second rater (Anthropic Claude) on a 449-record stratified sample (80% agreement, Cohen's κ = 0.61; both raters AI, no human rater) and the 126-record human-adjudication worklist (adjudication pending); UAI scoring data; and the Python scripts for deduplication, PRISMA counts, and the verification sample draw (seed-reproducible).

Note: title/abstract screening was performed by a large language model under explicit, human-authored eligibility rules, and evidence extraction was AI-assisted. The screening reliability check compares two AI raters; no human rater was involved, and human adjudication of the disputed records is pending. See the manuscript Methods and Supplementary Files S1–S4 for full provenance.
